csv_agency: IA Department Of Public Defense (Army Natl Guard)
csv_scope_of_work: The Department of Public Defense (DPD), on behalf of the Iowa National Guard (IANG), is seeking professional design services for the addition and alteration project at the readiness center in Waterloo, IA. This project is required to meet training, administrative, and operational space requirements of 1-133 Infantry Battalion HHC (WP5PT0) and its associated forward support element CO G 334th BSB (WPCRG0). Modernization and transformation of unit equipment requires more supply storage area than what is available in this facility that was constructed in 1954

title: AE for Waterloo Readiness Center Addition/Alteration
short_description: Design services for addition and renovation of a military readiness center in Waterloo, Iowa.
project_scope: Addition and alteration of the Waterloo Readiness Center to meet training, administrative, operational, and supply storage needs for the 1-133 Infantry Battalion HHC and associated forward support element CO G 334th BSB. The existing facility was constructed in 1954 and requires modernization and transformation to accommodate current unit equipment and increased storage demand.
services: Professional design services including architecture, structural engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, hydrology/hydraulics, and construction/project management.
